title_sq: Shesim Apartament 2+1 te Kompleksi Aura ne Rr. Dritan Hoxha
description_sq: Ne rrugen Dritan Hoxha, ne kompleks i cili ndodhet ne fazen e fundit te ndertimit me akses ne rrugen kryesore, shesim nje apartament 2+1 me siperfaqe 104 m2. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 1 te banimit, dhe ka nje organizim me 2 dhoma gjumi, 1 sallon pritje, 1 tualet dhe ballkon. Kompleksi eshte ne fazen e fundit te ndertimit dhe per pak muaj dorezohet. Ky apartament ka nje organizim shume te mire, kuadratik dhe eshte i mire ndricuar.
title_en: We are selling a 2+1 apartment in the Aura complex on Rr. Dritan Hoxha
description_en: On Dritan Hoxha street, in the complex which is in the last phase of construction with access to the main road, we sell a 2+1 apartment with an area of ​​104 m2. The apartment is located on the 1st floor of the residence, and has an arrangement with 2 bedrooms, 1 living room, 1 bathroom and a balcony. The complex is in the final stage of construction and will be delivered in a few months. This apartment has a very good organization, square and is well lit.
